name: ac-estate-and-succession
description: Preparing an investment portfolio for transfer: beneficiary designations and what overrides a will, titling and its consequences, estate liquidity and the assets that are hard to sell, the succession of accounts and access, the executor's checklist, and the written succession record. It frames the questions and the record; it is not legal or tax advice and never recommends an instrument. Use when asking "beneficiary designation", "estate liquidity", "transfer on death", "what happens to my accounts", "executor checklist", "succession plan". Not for writing the will itself (consult a professional), not for tax computation (ac-trading-records-and-tax), not for insurance coverage decisions (ac-insurance-and-risk-transfer).
